samples.question: The image has a REFERENCE polygon and candidates A and B. Each is a closed outline with eight uniquely colored vertex markers. A corner is convex when the boundary turns outward and reflex when it indents inward. A candidate matches only when every color has the same convex/reflex status as that color in the REFERENCE. Whole-panel translation and quarter-turn rotation are allowed; reflection is not. Ignore panel position, marker size, line width, and the order of colors around the outline. Which candidate matches? Answer A or B.
